$comment: Per-template Copilot primitive profiles. Every Golden Path ships the primitives its own generated repository actually needs, not a shared lowest common denominator. `scripts/build-primitives.py --check` verifies the materialised bundles offline; `--build` regenerates them from the pinned primitive source.

local.$comment: Authored in this catalog. Present in every profile because they encode Open Horizons platform governance rather than a technology choice.

base.$comment: The universal floor. The four skills and two instructions here are the supported default profile of the primitive source, so every generated repository satisfies it regardless of stack.

aeg-application.context: Governed Agentic Engineering Graph run that produces requirements, architecture, and an implemented application behind human gates.
aeg-application.deliveryNote: This template starts an AEG run instead of publishing a repository, so the scaffolder never writes files. The bundle is built and verified here and installed by the AEG control plane into the repository it creates.
